title: strobilanthes acrocephala
intro: Strobilanthes acrocephala, commonly known as the "Firecracker Plant" or "Khas", is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Strobilanthes acrocephala include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
